summary: Iteration 2 multi-store feature set verified end-to-end. Backend: 24/24 pytest tests pass (100%) covering stores CRUD + Cash auto-seed, cascade delete, per-store scoping on tasks/heads/accounting/chat, employee allowed_stores enforcement, admin vs employee accounting view (balances/entries hidden for employee), Cash head un-deletable, historical date fetch without auto-create, and WebSocket store scoping (cross-store broadcast prevented; 4403 close for unauthorized store). Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844): Login → Select Store ('Main Store' card + 'Manage Stores' button) → Home (store pill 'Main Store', admin cards 'Manage Users' & 'Manage Stores') → Operations (5 cards: Opening, Accounting, Closing, Chat, Reports) → Accounting (Cash head shows 'Count Cash' button instead of input; admin sees Opening/Closing Balance + Net + Total Credit/Debit) → Cash modal (all 9 denominations 5¢/10¢/25¢/$1/$2/$5/$10/$50/$100; live total computes correctly — entered 3×$100 + 4×25¢ = $301.00; Save persists and button shows $301.00) → Reports (date picker showing today + 3 PDF download cards). All flows pass.

action_items: No functional blockers. Optional polish: replace deprecated shadow* style props with boxShadow; investigate source of 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~720 lines; still acceptable but trending toward 'should split'. Consider routers/stores.py, routers/accounting.py, routers/checklists.py, routers/chat.py before iteration 3.
require_store_access correctly returns 404 for unknown store and 403 for unauthorized employee — clean.
Default store + Cash head + admin seeding on startup is idempotent (good). Backfills allowed_stores=[] on existing users.
Cash head protection via is_cash flag in delete_head is correct (400). Cascade delete in delete_store covers tasks, heads, entries, submissions, messages, and pulls from user.allowed_stores.
Employee accounting projection (opening_balance=None, closing_balance=None, entries={}) is enforced server-side — defense in depth is correct.
WebSocket /api/ws/chat enforces store_id required + per-store broadcast manager. Close code 4403 for unauthorized store works (verified).
Mongo _id correctly excluded everywhere via projections.
Frontend testIDs are now well-instrumented (login-*, store-*, cash-btn-*, denom-*, save-cash-btn, cash-total, net-amount, closing-balance) — testability is good.
